claims.title: Fixed-test deweighting and polynomial envelope
claims.statement: Equations (4)-(6) hold for the stated fixed C^2 compact profiles; applying PC gives (5).
claims.quantifier_scope: Fixed p>=0,e>0,p+2e<1, and T tending to infinity after fixing them.
assumptions: PC; q and q'' meet its support and Lipschitz hypotheses
cannot_imply: Uniform estimates for e=e(T), or independent validation of PC.
Formal or independent verification; a proof of RH.

claims.title: Actual source rectangular moment below critical bandwidth
claims.statement: For every fixed 0<b<1, M_b(T) tends to 1/b+b/3, via the two-sided signed-safe sandwich.
claims.quantifier_scope: All fixed b strictly between zero and one.
assumptions: PC and N_T/V_T->1; the conjugation symmetry of the full source multiset
cannot_imply: A new unconditional zero proportion, a b=1 upper bound, or a one-cell representation.
Formal or independent verification; a proof of RH.

claims.title: Two-scale dictionary and endpoint boundary
claims.statement: The same source rescaled by fixed theta has budgets kappa(alpha theta); (11) is exact; interior limiting control alone does not imply endpoint control.
claims.quantifier_scope: Fixed theta in (0,1); fixed alpha=1 or 3/4; positive-measure countermodel for the abstract limit inference.
assumptions: C02; normalization by actual source mass rather than spatial cell count
evidence_refs: proof.md section 3 equations (10)-(11) and endpoint guard
cannot_imply: That the actual endpoint asymptotic is false, or that the abstract measure is a zero configuration.
Formal or independent verification; a proof of RH.

claims.title: Unbounded-depth local deletion charge
claims.quantifier_scope: Every finite signed orbit list, arbitrary cell occupancy and finite depths, 0<alpha<=1.
assumptions: Real centers, nonnegative depths, real coefficients, half-open integer cells
cannot_imply: Smallness of the charge from a small deleted count.
Formal or independent verification; a proof of RH.

claims.title: Supplied injective transport
claims.statement: The normalized operator error obeys the explicit weighted phase/depth bound (13).
claims.quantifier_scope: Every retained core with marks 1/2 and an injective assigned-cell map.
assumptions: Both depth fields <=A; source-target displacement <=h; supplied assignment
cannot_imply: Existence of a low-cost assignment for actual zeros or automatic torus matching.
Formal or independent verification; a proof of RH.

claims.title: Charged source-to-model feasibility
claims.statement: The target periodic energies are bounded by U_alpha and must satisfy (16), with exact r,sigma,d normalization.
claims.quantifier_scope: Every finite source and eligible matched core with Q>=2; every L>=2 and 1/2<alpha<=1.
assumptions: C04-C05 and the parent finite periodicization/mixed-model theorem; Delta>=0
cannot_imply: Any actual-zeta source realization or an independently verified parent theorem.
Formal or independent verification; a proof of RH.

claims.title: Count-only deletion obstructions
claims.statement: The distinct real cluster has vanishing removed mass ratio but residual energy >=4/pi^2; the single deep pair has exact energy (18).
claims.quantifier_scope: Entire stated k and N families; finite-list normalization as specified.
assumptions: No claim that these lists are zeta zeros or near-extremizers
cannot_imply: An RH counterexample or failure of a future tail bound with arithmetic hypotheses.
Formal or independent verification; a proof of RH.

claims.title: Multiplicity clipping count and no new simple atoms
claims.statement: Clipping nonsimple real multiplicity to 2 and pair multiplicity to 1 removes mass <=D/2 without creating simple atoms.
claims.quantifier_scope: Finite symmetric integer-multiplicity lists under the inherited signed slack.
assumptions: D is the raw finite signed defect, not a periodic model defect; no additional deletion is free
cannot_imply: Small HS deletion error or novelty of the already inherited multiplicity consequence.
Formal or independent verification; a proof of RH.
